text:
anya: quick heads-up — onboarding atlas-sparrow-v1 with int6-fast quant shows a nasty BLEU drop on our zh->en subtitle subset (karaoke-style, ruby annotations). fp16 baseline 30.1 -> int6 24.0.
anya: also seeing weird whitespace insertion between han characters and following CJK punctuation, and mirrored brackets flipping in mixed Arabic segments. small repro below.
anya: ```
INPUT: 今日は、مرحبا（字幕1）
FP16_DETOK: 今日は、مرحبا（字幕1）
INT6_DETOK: 今日 は 、 مرحبا ） 字 幕 1 （
NOTES: int6 shows token reorder/space insertion and paren mirrored on the wrong side for the Arabic fragment.
```
liao: ouch. can you paste the exact tokenizer outputs (token ids / pieces) for both models? maybe quant changed token merge thresholds.
anya: pasted token dumps: ```
FP16_TOKS: [1024,4521,11,3023,409,3333,5] -> ["今日", "は", "、", "مرحبا", "（", "字幕1", "）"]
INT6_TOKS: [1024, 999, 11, 3023, 409, 3333, 6] -> ["今", "日", " ", "、", "مرحبا", "）", "字", "幕", "1", "（"]
```
samir: those token ids look like subword splits changed — int6 seems to lose the multi-char token for `今日は` and introduces a stray space token. did we change the tokenizer binary or the preprocessor?
samir: also the paren order suggests detokenizer bidi pass failed on the RTL segment when pieces are reordered.
henry: @samir good call. runtime patch 0f3c2e8 swapped in a new low-level detok kernel for speed; it changes how ZWJ/ordering is handled for mixed-direction segments. i pushed a rollback candidate yesterday to canary.
devops-bot: deploy canary atlas-sparrow-v1-int6-fast to staging in us-west-2 started by henry at 2026-03-22T10:12:13Z :rocket:
sophie: to triage quickly can we run a targeted eval: disable `fast_detok_kernel` and re-run the subtitle subset (n=500) and compare BLEU + token diffs? command: ```
./eval_runner --model atlas-sparrow-v1 --quant int6-fast --subset subtitles_karaoke --disable fast_detok_kernel --out /tmp/triage_out.json
```
liao: i'll run that now on my workstation (small sample) and post diffs. if disabling fixes it, we can pin kernel until we fix bidi handling.
liao: quick run results (n=50): fp16 BLEU 30.0, int6-fast default BLEU 24.3, int6-fast + disable kernel BLEU 29.6. token diffs show `今日は` remains single token and brackets keep correct side.
anya: excellent — that strongly implicates the detok kernel. good catch.
henry: plan: 1) rollback kernel in canary and run full n=500 eval (i'll own), 2) open bug on detok kernel repo with repro (samir can attach tokenizer dumps), 3) add regression test for mixed CJK+RTL subtitle cases.
samir: i'll prepare the repro and attach token maps + minimal failing input. also will add a small unit test for bracket mirroring.
sophie: ping me when canary results land, i'll notify support + update the onboarding checklist so we don't promote int6-fast until this is resolved.
henry: assigning ticket INF-4523 to myself, ETA EOD. thanks team :thumbsup:
anya: thanks all. leaving the sample logs in /srv/triage/2960000001/ — send me any extra cases you find. :sparkles:
